apply_rules: Apply in the listed order on the RAW content (context=edit). Every "old" matches content.rendered exactly once at its turn (matches_in_live), except "replace_all" entries, which match exactly "expect_matches" times.

Edits with "spans_tags": true replace a whole <table> element: if "old" does not match the raw content exactly (raw line breaks between tags can differ), locate the single <table> element that contains "anchor" and replace that element with "new".

Every other old string sits inside one paragraph, list item or table cell and holds no HTML entity. The rendered content shows straight quotes (ש"ח, מ"ר) and no texturized characters, so raw and rendered text are expected to be identical inside a paragraph; re-check each old against the raw content right before applying.

tier 1 = sale-price alignment with the official list (conflicts, stale and unsourced sale figures); tier 2 = rent or other figures with no dated source. Applying tier 1 alone is valid (tier 2 olds do not overlap tier 1 results).
All or nothing per page: if any old does not match, write nothing. Re-fetch the page first; another session may have edited it. Data only: nothing here was applied.

Tier 2 under the CEO rule (7.10.2026): apply AFTER tier 1 (tier 1 is already live on this page), on the live content, in the listed order. Each tier-2 edit carries ceo_action (replaced = an official dated value now stands there, with its source_url; removed = number gone, sentence or cell kept; deleted = sentence, row or column gone) and ceo_note.
notes: Every city-level 3/4/5-room figure on this page (second-hand and new ranges, the 3.0-4.6M 'regular flats' range, the 3.9-4.5M 5-room range) holds the official 1-3.2026 medians. The conflicts are the city average 3,520,000-3,657,246 (metrics table and FAQ) against the official all-rooms median 3,149,300, and the STALE 2023 neighbourhood sample averages (table + three FAQ answers). The rooms table and the 3/4/5 FAQ answers are restated with the official medians (verdict CONSISTENT on those edits); the FAQ answers keep the page's own consistent second-hand / new ranges after the median. The new-vs-second-hand table (tr@55388..55778) is consistent and kept. Not audited as claims: the if-example 'מי שרואה דירת 4 חדרים ... במחיר של 3,490,000 ש"ח' (p@45775, a hypothetical; it matches the dated Asirei Zion 11 deal), sizes in m2, months to delivery 12-36 / 30-180 days (tr@55997), counts of comparables (5-10, 10-20, 8-12), floors 3-5. Rent, per-m2 and the three dated May 2026 deals are kept (market data pages, page checked 5.6.2026). Unsure: (a) the two undated single-address rows (אסירי ציון 19, שדרות הנשיאים 42) are removed as tier 2; they could also be kept under the page check date; (b) the Mitcham 1200 check note is trimmed ('לרוב עם רף מחיר גבוה יותר' dropped) because its official 5-room median (4,225,600) is close to the city's (4,245,600); (c) the official neighbourhood 'שרת' (4 rooms 3,210,500, 5 rooms 4,014,000) is not added to the table because the page never names it and its natural name is not certain. Official quirk: the city 3-room median is published only for every other quarter (4-6.2024, 10-12.2024, 4-6.2025 and 10-12.2025 are empty), so it rests on few deals; the year-on-year change (+0.5%) compares 1-3.2026 with 1-3.2025 as published.
